brand_identity.name: Dobryi Energy
brand_identity.description: Energy transition expert (PV, IRVE, maintenance, security) for Agricultural, Industrial, and Public sectors in France. Genuinely award-worthy, luxury-industrial aesthetic.
brand_identity.core_concept: The intersection of raw industrial power and refined, net-zero opulence.

typography.strategy: Extreme font pairing (Massive Headings vs Small Technical Body Text) to create high visual tension.

primary_heading.usage: H1, large manifesto numbers, editorial statements. Used for high-end luxury feel.

secondary_heading.usage: Subtitles, Overlines, structural headings, button texts.

body.usage: Paragraphs, forms, technical data, and UI elements.

mono.usage: Data points, chapter numbers (01/), certifications, timestamps.

typography.install_instructions: Add Google Fonts imports to index.css or use next/font equivalents: Playfair Display, Manrope, JetBrains Mono. (Alternatively use standard serif/mono if unable to import, but apply tight/wide tracking rules).

colors.rules: NO generic full-screen gradients. Use deep solid colors. Accent colors (Emerald, Yellow) must be used sparingly for tension, hover states, or technical highlights.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#040914]/60 for the sticky header and floating WhatsApp pill. Add a 1px border of white/10.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise/grain overlay fixed to the screen to kill the 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.clipped_frames: Apply CSS clip-path to images to give them structural, architectural edges. Example: clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 40px), calc(100% - 40px) 100%, 0 100%);
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px subtle borders (border-white/10) to separate grid cells.

layouts_and_grids.global_spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Container should be wide but have max-w-[1440px] bounds with px-6 md:px-12.
layouts_and_grids.hero: Full height (min-h-screen). Intense, bold layout. Bottom-aligned text or heavily asymmetric. Do NOT center everything.
layouts_and_grids.manifesto_section: Numbered chapters (01/ 02/ 03/). Massive padding. Left-aligned numbers with deep indentation for text.
layouts_and_grids.solutions_bento: Tetris Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8. Make cards span differently (e.g., col-span-8, col-span-4). No boring equal squares.
layouts_and_grids.realisations_gallery: Spotlight photography treatment. Dark background, images have sharp clipped corners, on hover they go from grayscale to full color.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal for H1. Wrap each line in an overflow-hidden div, animate child y from 100% to 0 with framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_momentum: MANDATORY: Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.hover_craft: Cards: subtle scale-up of internal image, arrow icon slide-out. Buttons: Fill sweep or border tracing effects.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll to slightly translate the Y position of background images or floating elements in the hero.

components_strategy.header: Sticky, glassmorphism. Left: Logo, Center: Nav links, Right: 'Demander un devis' button. Do NOT hide nav on desktop.
components_strategy.marquee: Slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee. Text-6xl or 8xl, transparent text with 1px stroke (text-transparent [-webkit-text-stroke:1px_#F4F4F0]).
components_strategy.trust_bar: Animated counters for '10 ans de garantie', 'QualiPV 500 HTF', 'RGE Qualibat'. Monospaced fonts.
components_strategy.floating_action: Floating WhatsApp pill on bottom right. Emerald green or Solar Yellow, glassmorphism edge.
components_strategy.devis_form: Multi-step feel but elegant. Use raw HTML inputs styled brutally: border-b only, no side borders, massive padding. Focus state highlights border in Emerald Green.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract view of a modern solar panel structure. Use in hero with dark overlay.

architecture_glass.description: Modern glass building for 'A propos' or 'Tertiaire' sector.

irve_charging.description: Sleek EV charging station for the IRVE solution card.

security_workers.description: Construction workers for the 'Securite chantier' and Maintenance solutions.

agriculture_drones.description: Aerial drones over fields for the 'Agricole' sector background.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over images uses proper overlays. The background is very dark, so white text will pop.
accessibility.test_ids: Include data-testid on all interactive elements, e.g., data-testid='hero-cta', data-testid='nav-link-solutions'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis react-fast-marquee lucide-react sonner
Configure Tailwind for the custom colors, font families, and extend borders/clip-paths.
Set up Lenis in the root App.js layout for smooth scrolling.
Implement the masked text reveal in the Hero section using framer-motion (overflow: hidden on parent, y: 100% -> 0 on child).
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the marketing layouts to allow extreme asymmetry. Do NOT rely heavily on standard Shadcn cards; build custom bento boxes.
The Contact Form should look like a high-end editorial form (border-bottom inputs, no backgrounds, large text).
For the floating WhatsApp button, ensure it has a high z-index and backdrop blur.
All text is in French as requested.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder URLs or AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
